text: Relevant departments said they will continue to increase investment to further improve the urban public transportation network system.
src: 有关部门表示将继续加大投入，进一步完善城市公共交通网络体系。

text: Reporters learned at the press conference that this cooperation project will cover more than 20 major cities nationwide.
src: 记者从发布会上了解到，本次合作项目将覆盖全国二十多个主要城市。

text: Experts point out that the digital economy is becoming an important engine and supporting force for promoting coordinated regional development.
src: 专家指出，数字经济正在成为推动区域协调发展的重要引擎和支撑力量。

text: The implementation of this policy will benefit tens of millions of families and significantly reduce the public's burden of medical expenses.
src: 该政策的实施将惠及数千万家庭，显著减轻群众在医疗方面的支出负担。

text: As temperatures gradually rise, spring plowing and farming preparations are getting underway across various regions, and the supply of agricultural materials is generally sufficient.
src: 随着气温逐渐回升，各地春耕备耕工作陆续展开，农资供应总体充足。

text: According to the organizers, this edition of the expo features eight exhibition halls, with the number of participating companies reaching a record high.
src: 主办方介绍，本届博览会共设八大展馆，参展企业数量创历史新高。

text: Data shows that exports of new energy vehicles grew significantly over the past year, accounting for nearly 30% of total vehicle exports.
src: 数据显示，过去一年新能源汽车出口大幅增长，占汽车出口总量近三成。

text: The newly built sports center can accommodate 60,000 spectators and will become a new landmark building of the city.
src: 新建成的体育中心可容纳六万名观众，将成为城市新的地标性建筑。

text: The research team spent five years completing this project, and the findings have been published in prestigious international journals.
src: 研究团队历时五年完成了这项课题，成果已在国际权威期刊上发表。

text: The local government has taken multiple measures to boost tourism consumption, and the number of tourists received during the holiday increased significantly year on year.
src: 当地政府多措并举促进旅游消费，假期接待游客量同比明显增长。

text: This exercise focused on testing the emergency command system's coordinated operational capability under complex conditions.
src: 这次演习重点检验了应急指挥系统在复杂条件下的协同作战能力。

text: After three months of intensive construction, the renovation project of this old factory area successfully passed the completion acceptance.
src: 经过三个月的紧张施工，这片老旧厂区改造工程顺利通过竣工验收。

text: The report believes that the green and low-carbon transition will bring enormous market potential and opportunities to related industries.
src: 报告认为，绿色低碳转型将为相关产业带来巨大的市场空间和机遇。

text: Traffic authorities remind the public that highway traffic volume is heavy during holidays; please plan your route in advance before traveling.
src: 交管部门提醒，节假日期间高速车流量大，出行前请合理规划路线。

text: The laboratory has brought together a group of outstanding young scholars who have achieved a number of original results in the field of artificial intelligence.
src: 该实验室聚集了一批优秀青年学者，在人工智能领域取得多项原创成果。

text: The meteorological department forecasts that northern regions will experience strong winds and falling temperatures over the next three days, with sand and dust in some local areas.
src: 气象台预计未来三天北方地区将出现大风降温天气，局地伴有沙尘。

text: Data from the commerce department shows that the consumer market continues to recover, with the trend of online and offline integration becoming even more pronounced.
src: 商务部门数据显示，消费市场持续回暖，线上线下融合趋势更加明显。

text: This tunnel through the mountain range is over 12 kilometers long, and during its construction, multiple technical challenges were overcome.
src: 这条穿越山脉的隧道全长超过十二公里，建设过程中攻克了多项技术难题。

text: More than 200 infrared cameras have been installed in the nature reserve to monitor the activity patterns of wildlife.
src: 保护区内已安装两百多个红外相机，用于监测野生动物的活动规律。

text: The education authorities said they will continue to expand the coverage of high-quality educational resources this year and promote balanced development.
src: 教育部门表示，今年将继续扩大优质教育资源覆盖面，推进均衡发展。

text: The National Bureau of Statistics released data on last month's economic performance today.
src: 国家统计局今天发布了上月经济运行数据。

text: This space mission has successfully completed all the scheduled experimental projects.
src: 本次航天任务圆满完成全部预定实验项目。

text: The meteorological department reminds citizens to take precautions against severe convective weather.
src: 气象部门提醒市民注意防范强对流天气。

text: The newly opened intercity railway has cut the travel time between the two places by half.
src: 新开通的城际铁路将两地车程缩短一半。

text: The expert group has launched a comprehensive assessment of the disaster-affected areas.
src: 专家组对受灾地区展开全面评估工作。

text: This technology company has made a major breakthrough in overseas markets.
src: 这家科技公司在海外市场取得重大突破。

text: Winter heating preparations are now complete.
src: 冬季供暖工作目前已经准备就绪。

text: The municipal government announced the launch of a new round of renovation plans for old residential communities.
src: 市政府宣布启动新一轮老旧小区改造计划。

text: Research shows that the area of urban green space is positively correlated with residents' health.
src: 研究显示城市绿地面积与居民健康正相关。

text: Preparations for the National Games have entered the final sprint stage.
src: 全运会筹备工作进入最后冲刺阶段。

text: Relevant departments jointly carried out a major work safety inspection.
src: 相关部门联合开展安全生产大检查。

text: The newly built museum will officially open to the public next month.
src: 新建成的博物馆将于下月正式接待观众。

text: This year's grain output is expected to reach a new record high.
src: 今年粮食产量有望再创历史新高。

text: The nature reserve has captured footage of snow leopard activity for the first time.
src: 该片保护区首次拍到雪豹活动影像。

text: The organizers expect this edition of the exhibition to attract more than 100,000 visitors.
src: 主办方预计本届展会观众将超过十万人。

text: The medical team went deep into the mountains to provide free diagnosis and treatment for the villagers.
src: 医疗队深入山区为村民提供免费诊疗。

text: After the new route opened, passengers' travel time was greatly shortened.
src: 新航线开通后旅客出行时间大为缩短。

text: Relevant authorities have required all localities to make solid preparations for flood prevention.
src: 有关部门要求各地切实做好防汛准备。

text: The closure of the bridge marks significant progress in the project.
src: 大桥合龙标志着工程取得关键性进展。

text: The Employment Service Week for College Graduates starts today.
src: 高校毕业生就业服务周活动今天启动。

text: Most parts of the country will be sunny today.
src: 今天全国大部分地区晴朗。

text: The stock market closed slightly higher today.
src: 股市今日收盘小幅上涨。

text: The typhoon will make landfall in coastal areas tomorrow evening.
src: 台风明晚登陆沿海地区。

text: The new subway line officially opens today.
src: 新地铁线路今天正式开通。

text: Citizens flocked to the park to enjoy the flowers.
src: 市民纷纷前往公园赏花。

text: This edition of the exhibition lasts five days.
src: 本届展会为期五天。

text: The meeting issued an important statement.
src: 会议发布了重要声明。

text: Airport flights returned to normal this morning.
src: 机场航班今晨恢复正常。

text: The new library will open to the public next week.
src: 新图书馆下周对外开放。

text: Heavy rain caused flooding on some roads.
src: 暴雨导致部分道路积水。

text: The championship team returns in triumph tonight.
src: 冠军队伍今晚凯旋归来。

text: The environmental protection department launched a special inspection.
src: 环保部门启动专项检查。

text: The overall price level remains stable.
src: 物价水平保持总体稳定。

text: Giant panda cub makes first public appearance.
src: 大熊猫幼崽首次公开亮相。

text: Starting today, expressways are free for a limited time.
src: 高速公路今起限时免费。

text: The opening ceremony of the art festival was packed to capacity.
src: 艺术节开幕式座无虚席。

text: New energy vehicle sales have reached a new record high.
src: 新能源汽车销量再创新高。

text: The scientific expedition team successfully reached the target area.
src: 科考队顺利抵达目标区域。

text: Registration for the city marathon opens today.
src: 城市马拉松报名今日启动。

text: The renovation project of the old district has been officially completed.
src: 老街区改造工程正式完工。

text: I had originally planned to go hiking this weekend, but the weather forecast says it will rain, so I had to change my plans and rest at home.
src: 我本来计划这个周末去爬山，但是看天气预报说有雨，只好改成在家休息了。

text: I went to that restaurant you mentioned last time. I waited in line for almost an hour, but the food was really good.
src: 你上次说的那家餐厅我去了，排了快一个小时的队，不过味道确实不错。

text: He has been working at this company ever since he graduated from university, and two years ago he was finally promoted to department manager.
src: 他从大学毕业后就一直在这家公司工作，前两年终于升上了部门经理。

text: Our child is in the second grade of primary school this year and watches half an hour of cartoons first every day after getting home from school.
src: 我们家孩子今年上小学二年级，每天放学回家都要先看半个小时动画片。

text: The temperature has dropped a lot these past couple of days. Remember to dress warmly when you go out, and don't catch a cold again.
src: 这两天降温厉害，出门的时候记得多穿点衣服，别又感冒了。

text: I've been thinking about changing jobs recently, but given the current market conditions, it's better to be cautious for now.
src: 我最近在考虑换工作，不过现在这个行情，还是先谨慎一点比较好。

text: Yesterday, I found a wallet on the subway and handed it over to the station staff, hoping the owner will come to claim it soon.
src: 昨天在地铁上捡到一个钱包，交给了车站的工作人员，希望失主早点领回去。

text: If you had left half an hour earlier, you definitely wouldn't have gotten caught in the evening rush-hour traffic.
src: 你要是早半个小时出发，肯定就不会赶上晚高峰堵车了。

text: My parents are coming to stay for a while next month, so I plan to rearrange the second bedroom first.
src: 我爸妈下个月要来住一段时间，我打算先把次卧重新布置一下。

text: The lease expires this month, and the landlord said the rent will increase by 200 yuan per month next quarter.
src: 这个月房租到期了，房东说下个季度每个月要涨两百块钱。

text: At the class reunion last week, I almost didn't recognize several people—time really flies.
src: 上周同学聚会，好几个人我差点都认不出来了，时间过得真快。

text: I couldn't sleep last night and tossed and turned until after 3 a.m. before finally managing to fall asleep.
src: 我昨天晚上失眠，翻来覆去到凌晨三点多才勉强睡着。

text: The washing machine at home has been used for almost eight years and has been breaking down a lot recently, so I plan to replace it with a new one.
src: 家里的洗衣机用了快八年了，最近老是出毛病，我打算换一台新的。

text: Share this video in the group so everyone can watch it—it's pretty interesting.
src: 你把这段视频发到群里，让大家都看看，挺有意思的。

text: Over the weekend, our whole family went to a pick-your-own farm in the suburbs, and the kids had a wonderful time.
src: 周末我们全家去了趟郊区采摘园，孩子玩得特别开心。

text: I now get up at six every morning to go running, and after sticking with it for three months, I feel much more energetic.
src: 我现在每天早上六点起床跑步，坚持了三个月，感觉精神好多了。

text: The elevator in this building breaks down every other day, and the property management says they will arrange for someone to thoroughly inspect and repair it next week.
src: 这栋楼的电梯三天两头坏，物业说下周安排人来彻底检修。

text: My colleague recommended a bookkeeping app, and after using it for a month, I find it quite convenient.
src: 我同事推荐了一款记账软件，用了一个月，觉得还挺方便的。

text: Yesterday, I passed by the mall and saw the end-of-season sale, so I couldn't help buying two more shirts.
src: 昨天路过商场看到换季打折，忍不住又买了两件衬衫。

text: I have known him for more than a decade. We have been deskmates since elementary school, and we have always been very close.
src: 我和他认识十几年了，从小学开始就是同桌，关系一直特别好。

text: I plan to work out at the gym for an hour after work.
src: 我打算下班之后去健身房锻炼一个小时。

text: The tripe at this hot pot restaurant is especially fresh and worth trying.
src: 这家火锅店的毛肚特别新鲜，值得一试。

text: If you feel tired, go back early and get some rest.
src: 你要是觉得累，就早点回去休息吧。

text: The shoes I bought last week are really comfortable to wear.
src: 我上周买的那双鞋穿着特别舒服。

text: Let's go out to the countryside this weekend to relax.
src: 咱们周末去郊外走走，放松一下心情。

text: He worked overtime until midnight yesterday, so he definitely won't be able to get up today.
src: 他昨天加班到半夜，今天肯定起不来。

text: Mom says our homegrown tomatoes are growing especially well this year.
src: 妈妈说家里种的西红柿今年长得特别好。

text: Print two copies of this document and submit them to the front desk.
src: 你把这份文件打印两份交给前台。

text: I've been learning to cook recently, and it's going pretty well.
src: 我最近在学做菜，进展还挺顺利的。

text: The ending of this movie was completely beyond my expectations.
src: 这部电影的结局完全出乎我的意料。

text: I've just started reading the book you recommended last time.
src: 你上次推荐的那本书我刚开始看。

text: The road at the entrance of our neighborhood has finally been repaired.
src: 咱们小区门口的路终于修好了。

text: I’ve arranged to have morning tea with an old classmate on Saturday morning.
src: 我约了老同学周六上午喝早茶。

text: Did you bring an umbrella? It's raining quite heavily outside.
src: 你带伞了吗？外面雨下得挺大的。

text: The child has been clamoring to go to the zoo these past few days.
src: 孩子这几天总闹着要去动物园。

text: I tidied up the study a bit, and now it feels much more spacious.
src: 我把书房收拾了一下，现在宽敞多了。

text: This month's phone bill is quite a bit higher than last month's.
src: 这个月话费比上个月多了不少。

text: Guess who I ran into in the elevator today?
src: 你猜今天在电梯里遇到谁了？

text: The newly opened bookstore downstairs from the office has a great atmosphere.
src: 公司楼下新开的书店环境很不错。

text: I remember putting the keys in the bag.
src: 我记得把钥匙放在包里了呀。

text: Let's go see a movie this weekend.
src: 周末我们去看电影吧。

text: Have you had dinner yet?
src: 你吃晚饭了没有？

text: This item of clothing is on sale.
src: 这件衣服打折呢。

text: I'm going to the supermarket this afternoon.
src: 我下午去趟超市。

text: It looks like it's going to rain outside.
src: 外面好像要下雨了。

text: Please bring me a cup of coffee.
src: 帮我带一杯咖啡。

text: The subway is especially crowded today.
src: 今天地铁人格外多。

text: What have you been busy with lately?
src: 你最近忙什么呀？

text: The air conditioner in the room is broken.
src: 房间空调坏了。

text: Remember to remind me tomorrow.
src: 明天记得提醒我。

text: This store is closed on Wednesdays.
src: 这家店周三休息。

text: My phone is almost out of battery.
src: 我手机快没电了。

text: A new noodle shop has opened downstairs.
src: 楼下新开了家面馆。

text: Is your cold getting better?
src: 你感冒好点了吗？

text: Are you free on Friday evening?
src: 周五晚上有空吗？

text: The package has been left at the front desk.
src: 快递放在前台了。

text: I got a new hairstyle.
src: 我换了新发型。

text: This dish is a little spicy.
src: 这道菜有点辣。

text: Where did you go for fun over the weekend?
src: 你周末去哪玩了？

text: The car key is in the drawer.
src: 车钥匙在抽屉里。

text: Modern voice assistants typically first convert speech into text using speech recognition, and then use language models to understand the user's intent.
src: 现代语音助手通常先通过语音识别把声音转成文字，再用语言模型理解用户意图。

text: Training large models requires tens of thousands of graphics processing units to run continuously for weeks, resulting in considerable energy consumption and cost.
src: 训练大模型需要成千上万块图形处理器连续运转数周，能耗和成本都相当可观。

text: LiDAR can accurately reconstruct the three-dimensional structure of the surrounding environment by emitting laser beams and measuring the reflection time.
src: 激光雷达通过发射激光束并测量反射时间，能够精确重建周围环境的三维结构。

text: An end-to-end speech translation system directly maps source-language audio to target-language text, avoiding error propagation.
src: 端到端语音翻译系统直接把源语言音频映射为目标语言文本，避免了误差级联。

text: Federated learning enables multiple institutions to jointly train a global model without sharing raw data.
src: 联邦学习允许多个机构在不共享原始数据的前提下，共同训练出一个全局模型。

text: The precision of semiconductor lithography processes has reached the nanometer level, and extreme ultraviolet lithography machines are key equipment in this field.
src: 半导体光刻工艺的精度已经进入纳米级别，极紫外光刻机是其中的关键设备。

text: Autonomous driving systems need to fuse multi-source information from cameras, millimeter-wave radar, and ultrasonic sensors in real time.
src: 无人驾驶系统需要实时融合摄像头、毫米波雷达和超声波传感器的多源信息。

text: Speech enhancement algorithms aim to recover clean speech from noisy signals, with common methods including spectral subtraction and deep denoising.
src: 语音增强算法旨在从带噪信号中恢复干净语音，常见方法包括谱减和深度降噪。

text: Reverberation is caused by multiple reflections of sound waves within a room and significantly reduces the accuracy of far-field speech recognition.
src: 混响是声波在房间内多次反射形成的，会显著降低远场语音识别的准确率。

text: Neural machine translation has replaced traditional statistical methods, and its translation quality in many language pairs has approached that of humans.
src: 神经机器翻译取代了传统的统计方法，翻译质量在许多语言对上已接近人类。

text: The emergent abilities of large models refer to the reasoning and generalization capabilities that suddenly appear once the parameter scale exceeds a certain threshold.
src: 大模型的涌现能力指参数规模超过某个阈值后突然出现的推理和泛化能力。

text: The chip design process includes stages such as front-end logic design, functional verification, physical layout, and tape-out verification.
src: 芯片设计流程包括前端逻辑设计、功能验证、物理布局和流片验证等环节。

text: Channel coding enables the receiver to detect and correct errors during transmission by introducing redundant bits.
src: 信道编码通过引入冗余比特，使接收端能够检测并纠正传输中的错误。

text: The error rate of automatic speech recognition is already below five percent in quiet environments, but noisy scenarios remain challenging.
src: 自动语音识别的错误率在安静环境下已低于百分之五，但噪声场景仍充满挑战。

text: Multimodal large models can understand text, images, and audio simultaneously, and are seen as a path toward general intelligence.
src: 多模态大模型能够同时理解文字、图像和音频，被视为通向通用智能的路径。

text: Edge computing offloads inference tasks to end devices, thereby reducing latency and protecting user privacy.
src: 边缘计算把推理任务下沉到终端设备，从而降低延迟并保护用户隐私。

text: Digital twin technology builds dynamic models of physical entities in virtual space and is widely used in intelligent manufacturing.
src: 数字孪生技术在虚拟空间中构建物理实体的动态模型，广泛应用于智能制造。

text: Speech synthesis technology can now generate natural speech close to that of real humans, posing challenges to research on synthetic speech detection.
src: 语音合成技术已能生成接近真人的自然语音，冲击合成语音检测的研究。

text: Image compression algorithms exploit the visual redundancy characteristics of the human eye to strike a balance between quality and bitrate.
src: 图像压缩算法利用人眼的视觉冗余特性，在质量与码率之间取得平衡。

text: An object detection model needs to answer two questions simultaneously: what objects are in the image and where each of them is located.
src: 目标检测模型需要同时回答图像中有什么物体以及它们分别在哪里两个问题。

text: Deep learning models update their parameters through the backpropagation algorithm.
src: 深度学习模型通过反向传播算法更新参数。

text: Convolutional neural networks are particularly suitable for processing image data.
src: 卷积神经网络特别适合处理图像数据。

text: The emergence of large language models has changed the paradigm of natural language processing.
src: 大语言模型的出现改变了自然语言处理范式。

text: A speech recognition system usually includes an acoustic model and a language model.
src: 语音识别系统通常包含声学模型和语言模型。

text: The transistor density of this processor has nearly doubled.
src: 这款处理器的晶体管密度提升了近一倍。

text: Quantum entanglement is one of the core resources of quantum computing.
src: 量子纠缠是量子计算的核心资源之一。

text: Blockchain technology features decentralization and immutability.
src: 区块链技术具有去中心化和不可篡改的特点。

text: Autonomous driving relies on multi-sensor fusion to perceive the environment.
src: 自动驾驶依赖多传感器融合感知环境。

text: The cloud computing platform supports elastically scalable computing resources.
